schema.frame: all per-frame arrays have 900 entries indexed by 0-based frame i (t=i/30 s); null = not present/not measurable
schema.coords: pixels in the 1080x1080 frame, origin top-left, y down; angles in degrees, + = clockwise on screen
schema.card.visible: 1 if the card outline (white body + ink border) is detected
schema.card.cx/cy/w/h: centre and size from straight-line fits to the OUTER edge of the ink border (top/bottom/left/right sides, corners excluded). Includes border stroke (~2.5px).
schema.card.angle_deg: mean slope of top+bottom border fits; card.rot_rel_deg = angle - rest angle
schema.card.alpha_est: opacity proxy from border darkness: (248 - p30 gray of border ring)/(248-45). ~1 at rest
schema.card.shadow_xmax/ymax: outer extent (99.5 pct) of pink shadow pixels right of / below the card
schema.card.entry_profile: average over the 7 entries (N = [108, 180, 330, 480, 630, 735, 810]); k = frames after N. k=0: card invisible, headline alone
schema.card.entry_fit: easeOutBack fit to entry profile (see model string)
schema.headline.*: big red word. scale/rot_deg/dx/dy = similarity transform of this step's rest template (frame N+30) matched on a redness map (R-G-40)/100; dx,dy = shift of template centre; red_bbox = bbox of strong red fill (x,y,w,h); score = TM_CCOEFF_NORMED
schema.progress.fill_*: red fill bbox inside the track (x 672..922, y 722..746); w in px; null = empty
schema.progress.counter: counter text right of the bar, read visually from crops (null = no card / transition frame N)
schema.timeline.state: per node [6]: 0 none (not yet faded in), 1 empty (grey ring+grey number), 2 current (black ring, red number, red label), 3 done (red disc + white check)
schema.timeline.radius: per node: median over 48 rays of farthest ink (gray<225) within 32px of centre (150+156k, 927); px
schema.timeline.label_rgb: per node: median RGB of the darkest 30% label ink
schema.timeline.ring_min_gray: 2nd percentile gray in annulus r17-26 (fade-in proxy)
schema.timeline.check_white_px: white px inside a done node (check-mark draw-on); null if node not red
schema.timeline.seg_red_x1: per segment k->k+1: rightmost red column of the connecting line within x (cx_k+30 .. cx_k+126); null = no red
schema.timeline.events: frames where node state code changes
schema.timeline.pulse_fit: sine fit of current-node radius (global clock)
schema.oz.levels: 1 oz yc=682, 2 oz yc=620, 3 oz yc=559
schema.oz.N.grey_alpha_est: pending (grey) label opacity proxy (248 - p1 gray)/(248-75); dashed target line pulses with it; null = no grey label
schema.oz.N.red_bbox: bbox (x,y,w,h) of the red (reached) tick+label; null = not shown
schema.misc.title_red_bbox: bbox of red title ink above y=175
schema.misc.subtitle_bbox/p1: bbox / darkest gray of grey subtitle ink (y 165..235)
schema.text_rows: per card state: rows of ink in the median rest image: y0,y1,x0,x1, baseline (lowest dense row), top_dense, ink_height, colours

entry_fit.model: scale = s0 + (1-s0)*easeOutBack((k-t0)/D, c1); rot_rel = r0*(1-easeOutBack(...)); k = frames after N (headline-alone frame)

pulse_fit.model: radius(f) = mean + amp*sin(2*pi*f/P + phase)  (f = absolute frame; ring outer radius incl. stroke, px)
